data.cultural_impact: Manickam is a Tamil name that resonates deeply within the South Indian culture. It is a coveted name, bestowed upon children in hopes of receiving blessings of abundance, prosperity, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Manickam is the name of the lord of wealth, Kubera, who is regarded as the giver of all material possessions. This name is a reminder of the traditional belief in the accumulation of wealth, which is seen as a sign of success in society.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Manickam holds great significance in Hindu beliefs. It is believed that the name is ethereally linked to the god of wealth, Kubera, symbolizing prosperity, contentment, and spiritual growth. The nameManickam is a reminder that wealth is not just physical possessions but also the inner peace and happiness that comes with material abundance. The name is a constant reminder to focus on the spiritual aspects of life and to use material wealth for the betterment of oneself and others.

seo.title: Manickam: The Tamil Name Derived from the God of Wealth in Hinduism
seo.meta_description: Manickam is a Tamil name of Hindu origin meaning 'God of Wealth'. Learn about the meaning, cultural usage, and popularity of this name.
seo.description_paragraph: Manickam is a Tamil name of Hindu origin derived from the Tamil words 'mani' meaning gem and 'kamam' meaning desire or wealth. It is believed to be the name of the god of wealth, Kubera. This name is a symbol of abundance, prosperity, and good fortune, making it a popular choice among Hindus. Pronounced as 'Ma-nee-kam', it is often used to bless children with a prosperous and successful future.
